confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate, not checked against live listings. Restaurant, coffee and beer anchors are moderately reliable; accommodation is less certain given July rate variation. Cocktail and wine were set relative to beer (about 2.1x and 1.3x) because direct Florence price knowledge is weaker. The FX figure comes from a search-tool summary of the RBA daily exchange-rate page, not the F11.1 table itself.
comparable_city_reasoning: Rome (same country, similar restaurant and hotel tiers) is the primary calibration. Florence is set modestly above Rome for July peak-season hotel and hostel demand, with restaurant and coffee prices close to Rome. Bucharest and Amsterdam were used only to bracket overall price levels.
